title: Design System: OiAI ("Oops! I Ate It.")

components.name: Primary Liquid Button
components.description: Primary high-emphasis action button with asymmetric corners and rising liquid cocoa wave.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; padding: 14px 22px; background: #4b1e0d; color: #fff3d8; border: 1px solid #4b1e0d; border-radius: 2px 17px 2px 17px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.35s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6b2d17; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(75,30,13,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-arrow { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Outline Paper Button
components.description: Secondary action button with fine chocolate outline on cream canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 22px; background: transparent; color: #4b1e0d; border: 1px solid #865033; border-radius: 2px 17px 2px 17px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e7d2ad; transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Product Wrapper Card

components.css: .ds-card-product { background: rgba(255, 247, 230, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(75, 30, 13, 0.18); border-radius: 2px 2px 18px 2px; padding: 12px 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(77, 34, 13, 0.05); transition: transform 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.42s; } .ds-card-product:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 13px 0 rgba(77,34,13,0.06), 0 24px 36px rgba(77,34,13,0.12); } .ds-product-visual { height: 160px; background: #e6c89c; border-radius: 2px 2px 12px 2px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-product-name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #4b1e0d; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-product-desc { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #6c4933; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-product-price { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: #4b1e0d; }

components.name: Memory Story Card
components.description: Clickable story card on tinted biscuit paper with subtle organic rotation.
components.html:
MOMENT #01

components.css: .ds-card-memory { min-height: 280px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; background: #f8edd5; border: 1px solid rgba(67, 25, 11, 0.24); border-radius: 2px 16px 2px 16px; transform: rotate(-0.5deg); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(67, 25, 11, 0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.35s; } .ds-card-memory:hover { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(0deg); box-shadow: 0 12px 0 rgba(67,25,11,0.07), 0 20px 28px rgba(67,25,11,0.12); } .ds-memory-index { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.3px; color: #936542; } .ds-memory-art { height: 90px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 48px; color: #53210f; } .ds-memory-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #4b1e0d; margin: 10px 0 6px; } .ds-memory-snippet { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #6c4933; margin: 0; }

components.name: Organic Text Input
components.description: Parchment-backed input field with asymmetric rounded corners and warm cocoa border.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="What should we call you?" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgba(67, 25, 11, 0.24); border-radius: 2px 10px 2px 10px; background: rgba(255, 252, 242, 0.82); color: #43190b; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.25s, outline 0.25s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #8e4b2a; outline: 2px solid #a75a2d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b18a6b; }

components.name: Filter Tag Chip
components.description: Pill-style filter chip for mood tags and collection categories.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(67, 25, 11, 0.24); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 250, 238, 0.85); color: #43190b; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #4b1e0d; color: #fbf3e2; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-chip.is-active { background: #4b1e0d; color: #fbf3e2; border-color: #4b1e0d; }

narrative.overview: OiAI ("Oops! I Ate It.") is an artisanal chocolate house from Hyderabad, India, born from small-batch experiments and the joy of spontaneous indulgence ("Happy little accidents", "Tiny kitchen · Big feelings"). The visual identity avoids cold, clinical ecommerce grids and aloof luxury minimalism. Instead, it feels like an intimate, heirloom recipe notebook kept on a flour-dusted confectioner's worktable. Every viewport balances tactile paper warmth with rich roasted cocoa ink. Elements do not sit on a sterile digital plane; they behave like organic, hand-folded confectionery wrappers, wax-stamped tasting parcels, and handwritten notes tucked into gift parcels.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Paper Canvas: Atmospheric parchment background textures (#f4e7cc), subtle tactile grain overlays, and zero sterile pure whites.
Liquid Chocolate Motion: Organic liquid chocolate waves, slow-breathing melted cocoa hero elements, and glossy hover drips.
Asymmetric Handcrafted Geometry: Deliberate asymmetric corner radii (2px 17px 2px 17px) and slight organic rotations (-0.55deg to +0.7deg) mimicking hand-cut confectioner wrappers.
Three-Voice Typographic Harmony: Majestic literary serif headlines (Cormorant Garamond), intimate cursive margin notes (Caveat), and clean, legible functional labels (Manrope).

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Pure #ffffff and pure #000000 are strictly forbidden on the canvas. Surfaces must retain creamy parchment warmth (#f4e7cc / #fbf3e2), and text must remain warm roasted cocoa (#4b1e0d / #2d1008).

rules.name: The Golden Honey Reserve Rule
rules.body: The honey gold tone (#ddb778) is never used for general body text or large background fills. Its exclusivity denotes delight, ratings, and spontaneous celebration.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Every major section must establish clear roles: Cormorant speaks for the brand, Caveat speaks for the human creator, and Manrope speaks for the user's practical actions. Never use Caveat for form labels or long reading paragraphs.

rules.name: The Stamped-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain grounded at rest with subtle 0px-blur directional offsets. Soft ambient blur appears only when an interactive element is lifted into the air during hover or modal activation.

dos: Do preserve the warm parchment background palette (#f4e7cc) and roasted cocoa typography (#4b1e0d).
Do use asymmetric corner radii (2px 17px 2px 17px or 2px 10px 2px 10px) on interactive elements to maintain handmade artisanal charm.
Do apply subtle alternating paper tilts (rotate(-0.4deg) to rotate(0.5deg)) to cards in multi-item lists.
Do restrict Caveat handwriting font strictly to annotations, margin notes, signatures, and personal baker doodles.
Do use liquid chocolate animations and easing curves (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)) for meaningful interactive states.
donts: Don't use pure #ffffff backgrounds or #000000 text anywhere in the storefront.
Don't use generic symmetrical 4px or 8px pill buttons that look like standard SaaS component libraries.
Don't use Caveat for form labels, navigation links, or primary body copy.
Don't use cold blue, purple, or neon accent colors that clash with warm chocolate and roasted cocoa tones.
Don't remove the paper grain overlay or fixed page frame.
